classifications.rationale: The President directed the Trade Representative to pursue negotiations, an executive coordination activity that did not itself alter legal rights or require a specified agreement.
The segment describes a monitoring and reporting assignment to the Secretary; any later presidential action remained contingent.
classifications.evidence: directed the Secretary to monitor imports of automobiles and certain automobile parts and inform me

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory national-security finding and necessity determination that supplies the legal predicate for the section 232 action.
classifications.evidence: I find that imports of automobiles and certain automobile parts continue to threaten to impair the national security of the United States

classifications.rationale: This segment only recites statutory authorities and does not itself direct an agency or change a legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: Section 604 of the Trade Act of 1974, as amended (19 U.S.C. 2483), authorizes the President

classifications.rationale: The segment itself imposes a binding tariff, defines its application, establishes consequences for inaccurate content declarations, and creates a temporary USMCA-parts exception.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to a 25 percent tariff

classifications.rationale: The Secretary is assigned to determine which administrative tariff-schedule modifications are necessary, without this fragment itself making those modifications.
classifications.evidence: shall determine the modifications necessary to the HTSUS

classifications.rationale: The Secretary is required to produce later legally operative HTSUS modifications through Federal Register notice.
classifications.evidence: shall make such modifications to the HTSUS through notice in the Federal Register

classifications.rationale: The Secretary must establish an administrative process for possible later additions, but this segment specifies no article that must receive tariff treatment.
classifications.evidence: shall establish a process for including additional automobile parts articles

classifications.rationale: The required agency process must provide for the later inclusion of additional articles within the tariff scope when a qualifying request establishes the stated conditions.
classifications.evidence: this process shall provide for including additional automobile parts articles

classifications.rationale: This single segment inseparably combines agency determinations and administrative monitoring with self-executing foreign-trade-zone status, drawback consequences, and supersession of prior presidential provisions.
classifications.evidence: No drawback shall be available with respect to the duties imposed pursuant to this proclamation.
